public_result_contract.accepted: Input/current-run result logically accepted; NOT persistence. May be true on real write/readback failure.
public_result_contract.memory_applied: Valid result installed in Campaign memory only on actual verified write or QA suppression. False on rejected input/real failure.
public_result_contract.new_story_seal: Existing memory first-seal meaning; QA retained. False if valid result could not be applied after real failure.
public_result_contract.durable_new_story_seal: new_story_seal AND observed persisted; local ConfigFile readback only, NOT crash/fsync guarantee.
public_result_contract.persisted: Actual cfg.save==OK + entirely fresh cfg.load==OK + full section/key/Variant serialization semantic match + file SHA stable across read.
public_result_contract.suppressed: CAMPAIGN_QA=1 early path: no FileAccess/ConfigFile save/load/cloud call; persisted=false.
public_result_contract.save_receipt: Dictionary campaign_cfg_save_receipt_v27, including real prior/write/read errors, attempted flags, disk_state_unconfirmed, verified file SHA and Cloud callback observations.

receipt_contract.ok: Verified real local write OR allowed QA memory-only suppression; old _save bool returns this, not persisted.
receipt_contract.disk_state_unconfirmed: True after any attempted write that did not complete verified fresh readback; disk may already contain candidate. No rollback/retry/crash-safety claim.
receipt_contract.readback_semantics: Exact section/key sets plus typeof and fixed-safe-name per-value ConfigFile canonical text. NaN/-zero/math/Packed/Typed variants use ConfigFile serialization semantics, not IEEE bits.
receipt_contract.supported_values: Explicit Godot4.6.3 fixed data leaves: NIL/BOOL/INT/FLOAT/STRING/all math/Color/StringName/NodePath/10 Packed including Vector4; finite acyclic built-in typed Dictionary/Array. Root depth0; every recursive value node, including keys and scalar leaves, must have depth<=128.
receipt_contract.controlled_before_write_refusal: Any Object/RID/Callable/Signal, object/script-typed container, cycle or any recursive value node depth>128 refuses before save or canonical probe. This is a source-only budget, not native qualification.
receipt_contract.cloud_dirty_requested: mark_dirty requested after verified local cfg and candidate live memory applied.
receipt_contract.cloud_dirty_callback_invoked: Actual invocation only; may immediately return during _applying.

legacy_callers.change: Valid result computed with byteexact same-run best algorithm; rejected/failed actual save does not mutate records/unlocked. QA still mutates memory and old memory new_story_seal.
Signature/void behavior retained; stricter prior-load/readback failures can now return false internally. No new player-visible error/retry UI implemented; _last_save_receipt contains outcome.

Existing method/body byteexact; QA bool remains true. Real save/readback failure returns false. Existing pre-save cloud-memory replacement is retained and is NOT transactionally rolled back by this proposal.
Only after verified local readback; result records callback requested/invoked, not dirty state/upload. Record result commits live Campaign before callback so immediate _remember_local sees candidate.
Copies accepted/memory/persisted/suppressed/durable/save_receipt only. SteamService.settle, victory and mission result snapshot lines are original bytes.

outside_scope: Full gen2 lifecycle -> cfg -> ack transaction/restart/crash recovery
fsync/power-loss durability or atomic file replacement
Cloud upload or account ownership recovery
Player failure visibility/retry/pending HUD flow: HUD currently ignores new receipt
Public continue entry/natural victory/source6 qualification/Steam release/Android
Native GDScript parser/runtime and ConfigFile disk/fault QA not run
only_v27b_change: _cfg_value_supported noncontainer explicit current built-in whitelist; unsupported identity/future enum kinds default refusal. All original proposed27 methods besides this helper rawbyte exact.
